assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of syncope and palpitations in the setting of known atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
Mobile cardiac telemetry is ordered to correlate these intermittent symptoms with underlying arrhythmias and assess the efficacy of current rate control management.
The service is consistent with the documented indications for mobile cardiac telemetry.
The associated diagnosis codes are I48.91 and I25.10.
The diagnosis codes support the clinical context of atrial fibrillation and atherosclerotic heart disease.
The diagnosis codes justify this level of monitoring.
